thread:
maria: Quick sync — proposing a compact launch plan for Console Observability: dashboards (cost + errors), lightweight tracing hooks for hot paths, and a per-route cost-breakdown export. Short ask: agree minimal launch criteria and rough effort.

jonathan: +1. Prefer iterative: dashboards as read-only v1, hooks behind feature-flagged canary. Need perf guardrails. :thumbsup:

alex: For tracing sampling: default sample_rate=0.05 for prod, 1.0 for errors. Suggest config:
```
tracing:
  global_sample: 0.05
  error_sample: 1.0
  hotpath_rules:
    - route_regex: "/v1/generate"
      sample: 0.2
```

priya: Customers keep asking for per-route cost attribution (model + tokens). Export CSV + UI drilldown please. Also: enterprise will want SAML/KMS audit for Private.

sam: UX note: default dashboard should show top 5 cost drivers, 95th latency, and error % by route. Keep widgets small and copy onboard. I can mock tonight. :pencil:

opsbot: Created ticket PROD-4572: observability/compact-launch - tracing hooks canary + dashboards mock

maria: Proposed launch acceptance (draft):
- Dashboards: top-5 cost drivers, route error %, route 95th latency, cost export - GA draft
- Tracing hooks: canary at 10% user traffic for 14d, overhead <3% p50 CPU
- Cost breakdown: per-route, per-model token breakdown + CSV
- Tests: synthetic traffic showing no regression >2% on p95 latency
Can we get dev estimates and owners? @jonathan @alex

jonathan: Rough: dashboards 2 eng-sprints (1 eng + 1 frontend), tracing hooks 3 sprints (runtime + infra + rollout), cost export 1 sprint.

alex: I'll pair with infra on KV caching for hotpath traces; estimate looks OK. I'll add sampling config PR tomorrow.

priya: I'll consolidate customer asks and prioritize in the roadmap sheet: https://go/rdo-observe-compact

maria: Great — I'll convert this into a short spec and schedule a 30m sync tomorrow. Thanks all. :rocket:
